title: Track 1 live explanation evidence: durable, attributable, structurally proved
claim: Both Stage 5Q-1 evidence blockers are closed and each fix has been observed failing when removed. The first live slot of the day found a separate, larger blocker upstream of them.

safety_statement.scheduler_pid_change_cause: the OPERATOR restarted it again (33868 -> 6880 -> 28696); this session ran no start/stop command

evidence_layout.write_mode: truncate, scoped to the slot's own file
evidence_layout.rerun_semantics: a re-run of one slot REPLACES that slot's rows and nothing else; a day holds at most one record set per slot
evidence_layout.why_not_option_a: truncation was never the bug - it is what stops a re-run doubling a slot's own rows, and the decision file beside it opens 'w' for the same reason. A shared path was the bug. Per-slot files need no read-modify-write, no dedupe pass and no shared-file window
evidence_layout.traversal: refused, not sanitised - a name that needs cleaning is a name a caller got wrong
evidence_layout.replay_path: untouched and explicitly scoped: scratch/track1_shadow/explanations/<window>/ - a replay writes one window from one process

attribution.unrecognised_path: all None with shape='outside' - a third answer, not a default

previous_live_rows.state: global_index/track1_runtime held only two empty directories; no coverage file, no timing file, no explanations

freshness_proof.was: "freshness" in json.dumps(row).lower() - a substring test over the whole record including free text
freshness_proof.now: structural, defined in track1_explain (the module that BUILDS the records); the acceptance gate calls check_freshness_proof and holds no copy

rules.accepted_binding: must cite GATE.FRESHNESS (from ACCEPTED_PROOF_RULES_BY_MODE) and carry a boolean freshness_allow feature that passed
rules.accepted_replay: owes nothing - the gate reads today's inputs and did not govern an admission taken months ago (Stage 5Z)
rules.rejected: owes the feature only if a cited rule declares it; a cap refusal never reached the gate
rules.any_decision_record: must carry inputs_summary['freshness_allow'] as a boolean - the run's verdict as a typed field
rules.no_action_context: must carry a boolean freshness_allow feature - the record a day's freshness verdict is audited from

correction_to_5q1.was_claimed: the substring check was ALSO too strict - a real rejected decision contained the word nowhere
correction_to_5q1.is: wrong, and wrong because the probe was unfaithful: it built the record with an empty inputs_summary and the real writer always passes {'freshness_allow': <bool>, ...}

5q1_semantics_preserved.clock_only_refusal: WARN / window_shut, not a false FAIL
5q1_semantics_preserved.quiet_no_candidate_day: not failed by the committed daily gate
5q1_semantics_preserved.one_line_changed: a sleeve whose slots wrote nothing at all no longer prints 'it observed its window and found nothing to admit' - seen live beside three correct FAIL reasons for a slot that had crashed before reporting

blockers_before_5r.what: the live frame cannot be spliced - column mismatch
blockers_before_5r.detail: frozen frames carry open/high/low/close/volume; the IBKR live fetch returns those plus average and barcount. track1_live_frame.splice refuses rather than concatenating into NaN holes, which is correct
blockers_before_5r.impact: every sleeve hits this on every slot; no shadow day can be judged until the live fetch is projected onto the frozen columns (or the frozen frames widened)

blockers_before_5r.what: SpliceRefused crashes the slot instead of being recorded as a named refusal
blockers_before_5r.detail: observe_live_slot catches ShadowRefused, FreshnessRefused, LiveSourceRefused and NotImplementedError; SpliceRefused is none of them, so no slot_observed row is written at all
blockers_before_5r.measured: the Calm slot left a window_open line and nothing else
blockers_before_5r.why_not_fixed_here: it changes slot error handling, which this stage was told not to touch

blockers_before_5r.what: NKD after 2026-11-01: 12 of 22 ET slots fall outside the Tokyo decision band
the order gate remains open by design; orders are impossible

unfaithful_mutation_recorded.first_form: aimed at a test that drives emit_explanations directly
unfaithful_mutation_recorded.why_it_proved_nothing: the mutation edits the CALL SITE in observe_live_slot, and a test of the writer cannot see a call site (0/0/0)
unfaithful_mutation_recorded.fix: two new tests run the real observe_live_slot with only the bar source and the intraday gate stubbed
unfaithful_mutation_recorded.lesson: check the call site, not the implementation

global_index/maxhold_state.track1.json was written by the LIVE scheduler at 07:31 local ([TRACK1_MAX_HOLD_EXIT] completed OK) - exactly what Stage 5O built the marker for
guards_repaired_not_left_attributable.fix: absence was standing in for 'no test wrote it'; replaced with an mtime check against module-import time, which is stronger than absence ever was

guards_repaired_not_left_attributable.cause: they carried a `proofs` key no producer in this repo has ever emitted, so every test using them checked a shape that does not exist
guards_repaired_not_left_attributable.fix: rows are now built through track1_explain's own record builders

corrections_5q3.appended: 2026-08-24 (Stage 5Q-3). The record above is left as written.

items.was: B-5R-A (the column mismatch) was the thing standing between the route and a judgeable day: 'every sleeve will hit this on every slot'
items.is: it was one of TWO live-frame blockers. overlap_disagreement runs BEFORE the splice, so a sleeve whose instrument disagrees with stored history never reaches the column check. Calm reached the splice; Stress refuses earlier, with or without the schema fix
items.new_blocker: B-5R-D - one MNQ history bar (2026-08-21 13:45 ET, 'low') disagrees with the live feed by 4.5 points. A stored-history question, not a code one

items.closed: B-5R-A - the live half is projected onto the frozen frame's columns before the join, by track1_live_source.live_frame, the only caller of the splice guard
B-5R-B - SpliceRefused is caught and written as `live_frame_refused` with the guard's own code in detail

items.found_after: run_live_day_track1.py had NEVER imported slot_telemetry: slot_timing/ existed, RAITS_TELEMETRY_DIR was exported, and no Track 1 strategy slot had ever written a row, so no_timing_records was unsatisfiable and the p95 check could never run. Wired now; first measured runtimes ~2.7s against a 240s target
